sample_size.excerpt: Design: In total, 47,885 men in the cohort reported diet data in 1986 and every 4 y thereafter. From 1986 to 2010, 5861 cases of prostate cancer were identified, including 789 lethal cancers (fatal or metastatic).
sample_size.location: SUBJECTS AND METHODS, Study population, paragraph 1

cases.excerpt: From 1986 to January 2010, we documented 5861 incident prostate cancer cases (excluding T1a cases) during 941,471 person-years.

effect_size.excerpt: Higher quintiles of phosphorus intake were associated with greater risk of prostate cancer (adjusted RR for quintile 5 compared with quintile 1: 1.12; 95% CI: 1.03, 1.23; P -trend = 0.003) ( Table 4 ).

confidence_interval.excerpt: Higher quintiles of phosphorus intake were associated with greater risk of prostate cancer (adjusted RR for quintile 5 compared with quintile 1: 1.12; 95% CI: 1.03, 1.23; P -trend = 0.003) ( Table 4 ).

design.excerpt: After excluding men who reported a diagnosis of cancer (except nonmelanoma skin cancer) before baseline, a total of 47,885 men were followed prospectively for cancer incidence, metastases, and mortality until 2010.
design.location: SUBJECTS AND METHODS, Study population, paragraph 1
